name: Distance - ( d = | Ax ₀+ By ₀+ C | / √( A ²+ B ²))

map.点 (x₀,y₀) 到直线 Ax+By+C=0 的最短距离。: The shortest distance from point (x0,y0) to the line Ax+By+C=0.
map.d = |Ax₀+By₀+C| / √(A²+B²)。 原点到 x+y−1=0: d = |Ax0+By0+C| / sqrt(A2+B2). The origin to x+y-1=0 gives 0.7071.
map.原点到 x+y−1=0 距离为 0.7071。: The origin to x+y-1=0 gives distance 0.7071.
map.几何作图：求点到已知直线的最短垂线长度: Geometric construction: find the shortest perpendicular length from a point to a known line
map.碰撞检测/路径规划：判定点与障碍直线的最小距离: Collision detection / path planning: determine the minimum distance between a point and an obstacle line
map.坐标系验证：用距离 0 判定点是否在直线上: Coordinate checks: a distance of 0 means the point lies on the line
map.算法：点 P(x₀,y₀) 到直线 Ax+By+C=0 的最短距离 d=|Ax₀: Algorithm: the shortest distance from P(x0,y0) to the line Ax+By+C=0 is d=|Ax0+By0+C|/sqrt(A2+B2), the denominator being the normal's magnitude sqrt(A2+B2). When the point lies on the line, d=0. A and B must not both be 0 (otherwise it is not a line).
map.例：直线 x+y−1=0（A=1,B=1,C=−1）、点 (0,0) → |0+: Example: for the line x+y-1=0 (A=1,B=1,C=-1) and point (0,0), |0+0-1|/sqrt(2)=0.7071m and the normal magnitude is 1.4142. For the vertical line x=5 (i.e. x+0·y-5=0) and point (0,0), |-5|/1=5.0000m.
map.它是直线法向量 (A,B) 的模长，用于把带系数的代数距离归一化为真实: It is the magnitude of the line's normal vector (A,B), normalising the scaled algebraic distance into the true
map.；A、B 同时为零则方程不表示直线。: distance; if A and B are both zero the equation is not a line.
map.当点恰好落在直线上，分子 Ax₀+By₀+C=0，d=0；这正是判定点是否在直线: When the point lies exactly on the line the numerator Ax0+By0+C=0 and d=0; this is exactly the test for whether a point lies on the line.
